source_title: Falkirk: Ben Krauhaus winner 'best case scenario' for Brentford loanee - BBC
source_excerpt:
Falkirk matchwinner Ben Krauhaus was delighted with three points at Aberdeen, even if the performance wasn't the best.
The 22-year-old, who joined on loan from Brentford in the summer, came off the bench in the second half to stab home the only goal at Pittodrie.
"When you're on the bench you're not too happy but it's the best case scenario coming on and scoring the winner," the midfielder said.
"I think that's something the club's never done in the top flight, three wins in a row, so that was the goal before the game.
"It wasn't the best of games but it's always tough coming here. The result is the main thing and we got that.
"I said to the fans in my last interview to just stick with us because training with the boys every day I see we've got a very good squad.
"Every game this season we've been in the game, we might not have got the result we wanted in some of the games but we haven't looked poor in any of them."
